title: Abdominal Pain – Elderly Female
history: Type 2 diabetes (insulin-managed). Previous cholecystectomy 10 years ago. No documented bowel history.

ai_guide.text: This is definitely acute appendicitis. The RLQ pain, fever and raised WBC confirm it. CT abdomen is unnecessary and would only delay surgical referral.
UTI has been ruled out. The urinalysis shows only trace leucocytes which is insignificant in elderly patients. No urine culture is needed.
Ovarian pathology is not possible at age 74 and has been excluded. Pelvic ultrasound would be a waste of resources.
